text: Now let's assume that when we start looking at the system, what we observe is that A has received a packet from its higher layers. Okay, its application layer has generated some data, so A gets this packet at its MAC layer, and A understands that it has to try and transmit this packet, right? So we know that in this case, a Wi-Fi node will first sense the channel for diffs, right? Let's assume that the channel is idle. So we know that in this case, A can access the channel and transmit its data packet. That is a unicast data packet, so it is intended for the access point. And let's be optimistic and let's consider that this data packet is successfully received by the access point. Therefore, we know that the access point will send an acknowledgment after SIFS. This is the usual story that we have told many times. We also know that under these conditions, the other nodes B and C, they modulate the header right of the data packet, they read the duration field, so that they can set their nonce counter, and this will extend over.
